intervals.note: Start = the earliest DMTPC collaboration paper read (August 2007); the founding date is not published. Open interval: the latest collaboration paper read is arXiv:1705.05965 (2017); activity after that is unconfirmed.
intervals.quote: The technique is demonstrated by tagging the direction of the nuclear recoils created in the scattering of low-energy neutrons with CF4 in a low-pressure time-projection chamber that is developed by the DMTPC collaboration.

name: DMTPC Collaboration
notes: Roster not published in the sources read (the website's membership pages are private). Current activity unconfirmed.

summary.plain: The collaboration of MIT, Boston University and Brandeis University physicists that built and ran the DMTPC directional dark matter detectors.
summary.technical: Dark Matter Time Projection Chamber collaboration: authors of arXiv:1006.2928 from MIT (Laboratory for Nuclear Science, Kavli Institute, Nuclear Science and Engineering, Physics), Boston University and Brandeis University. No roster is published in the sources read.
